blocks: Comrades and friends:

Today we gather in solemn assembly to commemorate the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen; to honour his immortal contributions to national independence, social progress and the people's happiness; to learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit; and to inspire all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to unite and strive for the great cause of building a strong country and achieving national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

Dr Sun Yat-sen was a great national hero, a great patriot and a great forerunner of China's democratic revolution. In the years of his birth our country was suffering the savage aggression of the Western powers and the decadent rule of feudal autocracy, and the Chinese nation had fallen into the deep misery of turmoil at home and humiliation from abroad. Faced with a shattered land and a tottering state, the heroic Chinese people never submitted. Countless people of lofty ideals rose up to resist and searched painstakingly for a path to save the country and the people. Dr Sun Yat-sen was the outstanding representative among them.

Dr Sun Yat-sen "devoted himself to the national revolution for forty years". He spent all his energy and poured out his heart, fought his whole life to remake China, and made outstanding contributions to the Chinese people and the Chinese nation. He raised the banner of opposition to feudal autocratic rule, put forward the political programme of the Three Principles of the People (nationalism, democracy and the people's livelihood), and was the first to sound the resounding call to "rejuvenate China" (振兴中华). He spread revolutionary ideas widely and launched armed uprisings one after another, helping to build the momentum of revolution. The 1911 Revolution he led overthrew the monarchical autocracy that had ruled China for thousands of years, opened the floodgates of progress in China, and founded the first republic in Asia, profoundly advancing China's social transformation and exploring a path toward the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Influenced by the October Revolution and by Marxism-Leninism, and with the help of the Communist Party of China, he developed the old Three Principles of the People into the new Three Principles of the People, adopted the Three Great Policies of alliance with Russia, cooperation with the Communists and assistance to the peasants and workers, reorganized the Kuomintang of China, helped carry the Northern Expedition to victory, and pushed forward the democratic revolution against imperialism and feudalism.

Dr Sun Yat-sen's outstanding contributions are recorded forever in history. He enjoys high prestige in the hearts of the Chinese people and is sincerely revered by all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad. Today the Chinese people are advancing Chinese modernization with high spirits, and the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation has entered an irreversible historical process. At this moment, as we look back on Dr Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary career and honour his great achievements, our hearts are filled all the more with deep reverence.
Comrades and friends!

Chinese Communists are the most steadfast supporters, the most loyal partners and the most faithful successors of Dr Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary cause. Over more than 100 years our Party has led the people to great achievements in the new-democratic revolution, in socialist revolution and construction, in reform, opening up and socialist modernization, and in socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era, writing the most magnificent epic in the thousands of years of the Chinese nation's history. Many of Dr Sun Yat-sen's visions for building a future China, the grand blueprint he drew in The Fundamentals of National Reconstruction (《建国方略》) for building railways, laying highways, opening communications, harnessing water, cutting canals, constructing ports, and building factories and mines, have long since become reality, and in forms richer and grander than he imagined or described. Today our great motherland stands tall in the East. Its economy ranks firmly second in the world, the people's lives have reached all-round moderate prosperity, and the Chinese nation has achieved the tremendous leap from standing up to growing prosperous to becoming strong, and is making ever new contributions to the development and progress of human society. All of this can fully comfort the spirit of Dr Sun Yat-sen.
Comrades and friends!

For more than 100 years Dr Sun Yat-sen's call to "rejuvenate China" has inspired generation after generation of Chinese and has continually been given new meaning for its time. Today, the best way for us to commemorate Dr Sun Yat-sen is to learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, and to keep advancing the great cause of building a strong country and national rejuvenation.

Dr Sun Yat-sen loved his country and strove to save it all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must hold high the spirit of patriotism and strive to make the motherland prosperous and strong. Dr Sun Yat-sen burned with patriotic fervour, resolved "to repay my country with my own struggle". He held that "the greatest thing in being a person" is "to know how to love one's country", that "if the power to develop lies in our own hands we survive; if it lies in others' hands we perish", and that "saving China is entirely our own responsibility". Resolved to shoulder exactly that responsibility, to "prop up the great edifice before it falls", and so that China might become "the richest and strongest country in the world" and "the most peaceful and contented country in the world", he strove unceasingly all his life.

On the new journey we must uphold the unity of loving the country, loving the Party and loving socialism; uphold the Party's overall leadership and the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee; stay confident in the path, theory, system and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics; and inspire all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to deepen their love of country and temper their resolve to make it strong, carrying Chinese modernization forward to victory and together making our great motherland ever better.

Dr Sun Yat-sen cared for the common people all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must always put the people first and serve them wholeheartedly. Dr Sun Yat-sen had deep feeling for the people. He held that "the foundation of the state lies in the people", vowed "to seek the happiness of the people's livelihood", and believed firmly that revolution "is to remove the people's sorrows". He said: "What the people cannot do, we must do for them; where the people have no rights, we must fight for them." He stressed that "the Three Principles of the People exist for the people", advocated "equalization of land rights" and "regulation of capital", and worked so that "everyone enjoys the happiness of economic equality, with no trouble of inequality". So that the Chinese people might become "the happiest people in the world", he toiled and travelled all his life.

On the new journey we must remember that the country is its people and the people are the country; stand firmly on the people's side, grasp their wishes, respect their creativity and pool their wisdom; develop whole-process people's democracy; ensure and improve people's livelihoods so that the fruits of modernization benefit all the people more and more fairly; and take solid steps toward the all-round development of the person and common prosperity for all.

Dr Sun Yat-sen pursued truth all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must adhere to the "two integrations" and keep advancing theoretical innovation on the basis of practice. From his youth Dr Sun Yat-sen had the ambition to "contemplate the whole of heaven and earth". He studied advanced knowledge and useful achievements of thought widely, so as "to suit the tide of the world and meet the needs of society". After he threw himself into revolution he saw clearly that "to achieve the success of the revolution, we must rely on a change in thinking". He sought truth actively in revolutionary practice and worked to perfect his revolutionary ideas and his strategy of struggle. To bring about "the true solution of China's problems", he searched arduously and tenaciously all his life.

On the new journey we must integrate the basic tenets of Marxism with China's specific realities and with China's fine traditional culture, be bold in theoretical exploration and innovation, give scientific answers to the questions of China, of the world, of the people and of the times, keep enriching and developing the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as times change, and keep writing new chapters in adapting Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times.

Dr Sun Yat-sen was indomitable all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must be bold in tackling difficulties and open new frontiers for our cause through tenacious struggle. Dr Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary career met setback after setback and every hardship, yet he held throughout that "where my will is set I go forward without retreat; the more I am thwarted the harder I strive, and I try again and again". With a fortitude that "the hardships of a dead end cannot bend", he fought resolutely against every force that went against the tide of the times, and was not shaken by external threats, internal division or temporary defeat, displaying firm revolutionary will and fearless heroism. On his deathbed he still never forgot "peace, struggle, save China". He truly struggled for as long as he lived.

On the new journey we must take into account both the domestic and international situations, coordinate development and security, carry forward the fighting spirit and strengthen our ability to struggle, fear no difficulty and yield to no enemy, stand ready to withstand the major tests of high winds and choppy waters and even stormy seas, overcome every risk and challenge on the road ahead, and keep winning new victories in the great struggle of the new era.

Dr Sun Yat-sen championed unity all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must uphold the united front and keep consolidating and developing the great unity of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation. In advancing the revolution Dr Sun Yat-sen always stressed that "the revolutionary cause is launched by the masses and accomplished by the masses". He devoted himself to "awakening the masses", travelling everywhere, breaking through obstruction and seizing every chance to spread revolutionary ideas among people at home and overseas Chinese abroad, drawing more people to support the revolutionary cause and widely uniting all forces to "keep in step and put the country's long-term interest first, striving hard". Comrade Mao Zedong praised his united-front policy, together with the political programme of the Three Principles of the People and his spirit of arduous struggle, as "the most central, most essential and greatest legacy he left us".

On the new journey we must always keep to great unity and great alliance, unite all forces that can be united, mobilize all positive factors that can be mobilized, promote harmony in relations between political parties, between ethnic groups, between religions, between social strata, and between compatriots at home and abroad, consolidate and develop the broadest patriotic united front, and build a mighty force for advancing Chinese modernization.

Dr Sun Yat-sen had the whole world in mind all his life. To learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, we must vigorously promote the common values of humanity and actively help build a community with a shared future for mankind. Dr Sun Yat-sen looked at China's relations with the world from a broad vantage, placing the Chinese revolution in the context of the whole age and examining China's development within the tide of the world. He stressed that once China grew strong it "must also bear a great responsibility toward the world". He predicted that once the great goal of renewing China was achieved, "all of mankind will share a brighter future". He regarded "the world belongs to all" (天下为公) as "the aim of human evolution" and "what mankind hopes for", advocated an "open policy", and valued exchange and mutual learning among civilizations while refusing outright to "follow the old path of Western civilization".

On the new journey we must always keep the future and destiny of humanity in view, understand and handle our relations with the outside world correctly in light of the great trends of human development, the great pattern of change in the world and the great history of China's development, promote the common values of humanity, which are peace, development, fairness, justice, democracy and freedom, actively advance the implementation of the four global initiatives, and make China's contribution to building a community with a shared future for mankind.
Comrades and friends!

Dr Sun Yat-sen always firmly upheld national unity and ethnic solidarity, and resolutely opposed all words and deeds that would split the country or divide the nation. He stressed that "China is a unified country", declared that "'unification' is the hope of all the citizens of China", and pledged "to use all my influence to strive for the unification of the country". His strong wish and firm will for the reunification of the motherland have always enlightened, educated and inspired all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation.

Through the long river of more than 5,000 years of Chinese civilization, the conviction that the land must not be divided, the state must not fall into chaos, the nation must not be scattered and the civilization must not be broken has always been engraved in the bones of every son and daughter of the Chinese nation. Resolving the Taiwan question and achieving the complete reunification of the motherland is a historic task to which the Communist Party of China is unswervingly committed, the shared aspiration of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation, and an inevitable requirement for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

Compatriots on both sides of the Strait are all Chinese, one family bound by blood, with blood thicker than water. When family members get along, as long as they talk things over properly and consult on matters together, there is no contradiction or difference that cannot be resolved. For a long time we have held to the idea that "both sides of the Strait are one family", kept deepening exchanges and integration across the Strait, and improved the well-being of compatriots on both sides. Looking to the future, we adhere to the policy of "peaceful reunification and one country, two systems". On the basis of adhering to the one-China principle and the "1992 Consensus", we are willing to conduct dialogue and consultation on cross-Strait relations and national reunification with people of insight from all sectors in Taiwan. We will give full consideration to Taiwan's actual circumstances and full regard to the interests and feelings of Taiwan compatriots, but we will never leave any room for "Taiwan independence" separatist activities in any form.

Taiwan's future lies in national reunification, and the interests and well-being of Taiwan compatriots are bound up with the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Compatriots on both sides of the Strait and all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad must join hands to oppose "Taiwan independence" separatist forces together and to work together for the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations and the complete reunification of the motherland. The tide of history cannot be stopped. The complete reunification of the motherland must be achieved, and it certainly can be achieved!
Comrades and friends!

Comprehensively advancing the great cause of building a strong country and national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization is the new Long March of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese people, and the only path to realizing Dr Sun Yat-sen's ideal of "rejuvenating China". I call on all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to unite more closely, carry on Dr Sun Yat-sen's unfinished cause, work together with one heart for the great undertaking of the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and keep turning the great dream that the people of all our ethnic groups have pursued since modern times into a beautiful reality!
